messages.author: 9ae91953654197a0
messages.subject: Error using distances()
parts:
Hi Chris,

I am running into an error when using the distances() in ctmm. I was wondering if you could provide some help please.
The error given is:
Error in if (Barg >= BESSEL_LIMIT) { : 
missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

Here is the code I am using:
pair7 <- DATA_TELEMETRY[c("Rodolfo", "Elaine")]
FIT_pair7 <- FIT[c("Rodolfo", "Elaine")]
distance_pair7 <- distances(pair7, FIT_pair7)

I am one of Dr. Michael Noonan's student and he mentioned it might be a bug with ctmm. He tried to do some troubleshooting but no avail. He also checked the projection and it is the same, here is the output:
> FIT_pair7[[1]]@info $identity [1] "Rodolfo" $timezone [1] "UTC" $projection [1] "+proj=tpeqd +lat_1=-21.0137279503679 +lon_1=-53.948565086249 +lat_2=-21.6310600957784 +lon_2=-53.5894070961844 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"

> FIT_pair7[[2]]@info $identity 
[1] "Elaine" $timezone 
[1] "UTC" $projection 
[1] "+proj=tpeqd +lat_1=-21.0137279503679 +lon_1=-53.948565086249 +lat_2=-21.6310600957784 +lon_2=-53.5894070961844 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"

I have attached the RDS files for the data and the fitted model for your reference. I'm not running into any other problems when running distances() with my entire dataset or with any of the other pairs, only this particular one. Moreover, it previously worked but now it gives me that error. Please let me know if you require additional information. Thank you.

Regards,
Kat Chhen
